ai_quote: The startup builds an AI-powered operating platform for waste-hauling businesses

company.description: AI-powered operating platform for waste-hauling businesses combining dispatching, route planning, customer management, billing and payments, with an AI agent called Haul-E that answers customer calls and takes orders.
company.name: TrashLab Software

source_quote: San Francisco-based TrashLab Software recently raised $12 million in a growth funding round led by Ventana , with participation from existing investors Bienville Capital , Harlem Capital and CreativeCo .
